d: Donald Trump has admitted that his mass deportation campaign may have gone too far, following a bruising midterm defeat for Republicans. But his next move raises serious questions about whether he has learned anything from the voters' verdict. Instead of changing course, Trump has elevated Stephen Miller, the architect of his hard-line immigration agenda, to White House chief of staff. Who is Miller, what does he believe, and how much power will he now wield? From mass deportations to presidential authority, we examine Miller's controversial ideology and what his promotion signals about…
